caption: The drawing depicts the head and upper neck of a horse, rendered in shades of black and gray on a light, nearly white background. The horse’s head is shown in profile, facing left, with a large, round ring passing through its open mouth. The mane is stylized with curved lines, and details of the eyes, nostrils, and ears are carefully delineated. The base of the neck ends abruptly as if mounted on a platform or plinth, suggested by a shaded rectangular block below the neck. The entire composition uses smooth shading and highlights to convey the contours and form of the horse’s head and the metallic or glossy surface texture. There are no additional objects or colors present in the drawing apart from the grayscale representation of the horse’s head, ring, and base.
title: Horse Head Hitching Post
